snp5.17:1.1: I’m old & weak, my complexion dull,
snp5.17:1.3: I’ve blurry eyes and trouble hearing—
snp5.17:1.4: but may I not perish while still deluded, confused!
snp5.17:1.5: Teach me the Dhamma so that I may know
snp5.17:1.6: the abandoning here of birth & aging.
snp5.17:2.3: on account of their bodies— heedless people are afflicted on account of their bodies—
snp5.17:2.5: let go of the body for the sake of no further becoming.
snp5.17:3.1: Piṅgiya: In the four cardinal directions, the four intermediate,
snp5.17:3.3: there is nothing in the world unseen, unheard,
snp5.17:3.5: Teach me the Dhamma so that I may know
snp5.17:3.6: the abandoning here of birth & aging.
snp5.17:4.1: The Buddha: Seeing people, victims of craving—
snp5.17:4.6: for the sake of no further becoming.
